description: Source code for parsing device descriptors and related XML data, including functions for handling device version lists, metadata, and device descriptor base parsing, as well as specific parsing for camera and Zigbee device descriptors.

methods.name: getTrimmedXmlNodeContentsAsString
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the contents of an XML node.

methods.name: parseDeviceVersionList
methods.description: Parses a device version list from an XML node.

methods.name: versionStringToDecimalString
methods.description: Converts a version string (hex or decimal) to a decimal string.

methods.name: parseZigbeeDeviceVersion
methods.description: Parses Zigbee device version information from an XML node.

methods.name: parseMetadataList
methods.description: Parses metadata entries from an XML node into a hash map.

methods.name: parseDescriptorBase
methods.description: Parses common device descriptor fields from an XML node.

methods.name: parseCameraMotionNode
methods.description: Parses motion-related settings from a camera motion XML node.

methods.name: parseCameraDescriptor
methods.description: Parses camera-specific device descriptor information from an XML node.

methods.name: getBlacklistedUuids
methods.description: Reads a blacklist XML file and returns a hash map of blacklisted UUIDs.

methods.name: parseDeviceDescriptors
methods.description: Parses device descriptor list from whitelist and blacklist XML files, returning a linked list of device descriptors.
